info.title: BuildX / Hippo BuildX API
info.description:
Phase 0–2 platform + tenant admin + Property/Planning APIs.

**Auth:** HttpOnly cookies or Bearer JWT.

**Phase 2:** Project→Block→Tower→Floor→Unit hierarchy, bulk generation, unit status history, milestones/tasks/FS deps/Gantt, BOQ, versioned drawings/RFIs, issues, approvals, project budget.

**UI guide:** docs/UI-BACKEND-GUIDE.md
